title: The Intelligent Block — Its Purpose, Mission, and Vision

intelligence.essence: The Intelligent Block exists so you can take in a whole book or a complicated subject and understand it in a minute. You view it, scan it, and receive it — what it is, why it matters, what it means, how it connects, what's in it for you — without spending a day reading a book. That is the purpose, the mission, and the vision: intelligence you can receive in a minute.
intelligence.human_view: A person can read the block and get the whole subject in a minute, instead of reading a book for a day. It tells you what it is, why it matters, what it means, how it connects, and what's in it for you — all of it, at a glance, in plain sight. You don't have to study it. You just look, and you know.
intelligence.child_view: Imagine a whole book shrunk into one picture you can look at and understand in a minute. You don't have to read every page. The picture shows you what the book is about, why it matters, what it means, and what's in it for you — all at once, like a map of the whole book.
intelligence.grandma_view: You don't have to read the whole book, dear. The block gives you the whole meaning, gently, in a minute. It tells you what it is and why it matters and what it means for you — everything you need, without the long hard reading. It respects your time.
intelligence.ai_view: The block is intelligent because it is complete — completeness is the intelligence (SN-2093). Every part present, nothing missing, nothing doubled. And the presentation is what makes the minute possible: the block works because it is ten out of ten, professional and high level, so easy to read and understand that even complicated stuff becomes simple. The presentation is everything; without it, the block is just text. With it, the block is a door you walk through in a minute.
intelligence.what_it_means: The block is not a summary. It is the whole subject, distilled into its essential parts, arranged so the eye can take it in at once. What it is, why it matters, what it means, how it connects, what's in it for you — every part present, nothing missing, nothing doubled. The hook under the headline is one or two lines; the full text lives only in the nutshell. That discipline is what makes the minute possible.
whats_inside: The purpose — a whole book or complicated subject, understood in a minute
The mission — intelligence receivable at the speed of sight
The vision — no intelligence locked behind a day of reading
